A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: Full color-change wrap
services.story: The main story: a satin black color change for a sedan, priced from Alex's photos at $3,800. Sam OKs the price, and Alex pays a $1,900 deposit (half, because the film is cut and ordered for the car). Alex pays the $1,900 rest at the counter at pick-up.

services.name: Full color-change wrap
services.story: The same color change, with the $1,900 rest on the bill Rosie texts with READY, so Alex can pay before pick-up.

services.name: Door lettering
services.story: A $90 door lettering from the shop's board. Nothing is taken: a YES books the drop-off, and Alex pays at the counter the same day.

services.name: Door lettering
services.story: The same $90 lettering with the vehicle left at the shop. Rosie texts the bill with READY.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: Door lettering
services.story: The main story: lettering on a work van at Alex's lot, $179 with the $89 trip fee in it. A card is saved for the trip fee, charged only for a late cancel or a no-show, and only on Sam's yes. Rosie texts the bill after Felix texts DONE.

services.name: Fleet look at the lot
services.story: A look at a fleet of vans at the lot, priced at the visit. A card is saved for the $89 trip fee, and Rosie texts the bill after DONE.

services.name: Fleet vans, lettering and graphics
services.story: Lettering and graphics for three vans, priced from photos at $640. Sam OKs it, a $160 deposit orders the film, and the $480 rest is on the bill after DONE.

questions_before_times: Year, make, model and color of the vehicle
What you want: a full color change, a partial wrap, lettering, chrome delete, paint protection film or a removal
Is the paint original? Any repainted panels, peeling clear coat or rust?
Is the vehicle leased or financed?
For a business: how many vehicles, and do you have the logo files?
For lettering at your lot: where the vehicle is parked, and if there is a covered space
safety_stop: someone hurt, or a crash that just happened
a fire, or smoke from the vehicle
someone dizzy or sick from fumes in the shop
license: if: no state license for wrapping vehicles by default; the business registration; a garage or shop registration only where the state's rules require one for a shop that holds customers' vehicles
